inputs.name: users
inputs.type:
map(object({
    uid    = optional(number)
    shell  = optional(string, "/bin/bash")
    home   = optional(string)
    groups = optional(list(string))
    keys   = optional(list(string), [])
    sudo   = optional(bool, false)
  }))
inputs.description: The accounts to manage, keyed by login name.
